messages:
DeployBot: FYI — scheduled deploy for release/3.4.0 at 2025-11-03T22:00:00Z. Hard-freeze window starts 2025-11-03T20:00:00Z. Pin: gateway -> v3.4.0-rc3. This thread = handoff + rollback contact.
Alice M: Copy. Are we keeping the embedding model on the new quantized build for this rollout?
Ben R: Yes — embeddings -> em-slim-q8 by default. I verified model artifacts in staging.
Carla: Quick checklist: 1) Docs & release notes updated 2) Canary buckets set 3) Metrics dashboard pinned 4) SLA owners notified
Sam O: I'll own post-deploy burn for first 30m. Watchlist: p50 latency, 5xx rate, memory OOMs.
Lee H: Observability links: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/3.4.0 and runbook https://runbooks.redwood.ai/rollouts. I also pushed a temporary alert: canary-error-rate > 2% -> pager.
Alice M: Canary plan: 10% for 15m, if stable -> 50% for 20m, then 100% ramp. Rollback triggers: any sustained 5xx > 1.5%, error spike > 3x baseline, or p50 increase > 200ms.
Ben R: Ops note: we pinned DB migrations to be backward-compatible. Migration batch size = 5000 rows/min, toggle = off by default until 50% traffic.
Carla: Release notes snippet ready in PR #482: "3.4.0 — performance fixes, embeddings quantized, gateway improvements."
Sam O: Heads-up: I'll be at the pager console at T+0. Minutes into deploy I'll run smoke steps:
```
# smoke checklist
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'
check_grafana canary_error_rate
```
Lee H: Deploy command we'll use (deploy-bot):
`/deploy release/3.4.0 --canary 10% --buckets 3 --timeout 1200s`
Alice M: One exception: embeddings hotfix team may request exemption from hard-freeze until +2h if we detect batch failures. Any objections?
Ben R: Fine, but require explicit approval in thread.
Carla: Approved process: post request + owner signoff + QA verify. No silent exceptions.
DeployBot: rolling canary started at 2025-11-03T22:00:45Z — bucket 1 (10%). Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/deploys/3056789012
Sam O: Canary smoke passed at T+3m. No 5xx, p50 stable. Moving to 50% ramp.
DeployBot: ramping to 50% at 2025-11-03T22:18:12Z
Lee H: Alerting saw a tiny spike at T+7m, reverted alert noise. Nothing actionable.
Carla: 50% steady for 20m, metrics green. Proceed to full.
Ben R: Gate: enable migrations at 50% now. Toggling migration flag -> ON.
DeployBot: final ramp to 100% completed at 2025-11-03T22:45:02Z. All pods reporting ready.
Alice M: Post-deploy notes: tagging release artifacts, updating changelog, sending release announcement in #announcements.
Sam O: I'll keep monitoring for next 2h, then hand back to eng-sre.
Lee H: All good from observability side, removing temporary pager rule.
Carla: Closing hard-freeze at 2025-11-03T23:00:00Z. Thanks everyone :tada:
DeployBot: Deploy summary: success, duration 45m, no rollback. Artifacts: s3://releases/3.4.0.
